_doc: AWA's REAL intent-catalog/v1. Authored by AWA, read-only to the router. Every ordinary PM-facing string is deliberately jargon-free; the immutable finish warning has its own narrowly scoped egress exception. The original five operator outcomes remain unchanged, and additive finish_current is a separate sixth outcome whose deterministic recognizer runs before generic routing and only starts Phase-1 preview.

examples: I want to keep my changes safe
set up a safe place to work
preconditions: there is a project to protect
verbs.consequence_copy: Sets up a separate safe copy for you to work in, so your original files stay exactly as they are.

examples: check that my work is safe
verbs.plain_label: Check whether your work is protected
verbs.consequence_copy: Nothing changes. This only tells you whether your work is safe right now and what, if anything, still needs attention.

examples: show me all my safe copies
show me the work I've kept safe
verbs.consequence_copy: Nothing changes. This lists the safe copies you already have so you can see them at a glance.

aliases: pick up where I left off
examples: go back to the work I protected earlier
pick up where I left off yesterday
continue the work I saved before
preconditions: a protected copy exists to go back to
verbs.plain_label: Go back to work you protected earlier
verbs.consequence_copy: Opens a safe copy you set up before, so you can keep working in it. Your other work stays as it is.

examples: save the work in my safe copy
keep the changes I just made
verbs.consequence_copy: Records the current state of your safe copy so you can come back to exactly this point later. Nothing is removed.

aliases: get rid of an old copy
examples: clean up my old safe copy
delete a safe copy I no longer need
get rid of this safe copy
preconditions: the safe copy's work is already saved somewhere else
verbs.consequence_copy: Removes a safe copy you no longer need. Anything inside it that was not already saved somewhere else would be lost for good.

preconditions: the current workspace is a temporary safe copy
verbs.consequence_copy: Prepares a complete warning and waits for one exact choice. It does not remove anything by itself.
